title: Validate assets by role and the actual export codec
when: Comparing embedded PNGs with images extracted from native PDF.
do: Use manifest hashes for original/restored HWPX assets.
Account for Hancom JPEG recompression when comparing PDF decoded pixels.
Keep original evidence and clean reconstruction as distinct roles.
check: Role coverage, source bindings and dimensions match; codec effects do not become false semantic errors.
limitation: Historical tolerance values are fixture-specific, not a universal visual similarity threshold.
